lesson.menu_desc: Narrate a heat as it happens -- present continuous -- 27 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 3 -- Live from the Beach
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Renato | Lesson 3 -- Live from the Beach

listenings.text: Four minutes to go in the final here, and it is getting tense. The surfer in yellow has priority and she is sitting deep, waiting for a bigger set. The other one is paddling north, looking for something on the inside. The judges are watching from the tower, the commentators are all talking at once, and the crowd on the sand is standing up. Oh, here we go. She is up, she is dropping into it, and she is disappearing inside the barrel. Listen to that. Everybody is cheering. Four minutes left, and this heat is not over.

Hey, it's me. I am sitting on the sand and I am waiting for my heat. It starts in twenty minutes. My coach is standing at the water with his arms crossed, watching the waves and counting the sets, like he always does. My sister is filming everything on her phone. The swell is getting bigger and honestly I am a bit nervous, but the good kind of nervous. Right, they are calling my name. Talk later.

items.situation: A friend calls you during a heat and asks what is going on. Describe it in three sentences.
Somebody asks: "Are you competing today?" Answer, and say what you are doing instead.
Your coach asks why you are not paddling for the wave. Explain.
You are on a video call and the person asks what the weather is doing where you are.
Describe what three different people around you are doing right now, in one go.
